app-name: The name of the app to scan
urlTarget: The URL of the target application
strength: The strength with which the analysis will be runn (low, medium, high)

authenticated.username: The username to be used to log-in the application
authenticated.passwd: The password to be used to log-in the appplication
authenticated.login-page: The page where the login form is (e.g. login.php)
authenticated.logout-page: The page where the logout happens (e.g. logout.php)

spider.max-children: The maximum number of child nodes (per node) that can be crawled (default value 0 = no limit)
spider.max-depth: The maximum depth the spider can crawl (default value 0 = no limit)
spider.max-duration: The maximum duration the spider can crawl (in minutes)
spider.max-dps: The maximum size, in bytes, that a response might have to be parsed. This allows the spider to skip big responses/files

ajax-spider.max-crawl-depth: The maximum depth the ajax spider can crawl (default value 0 = no limit)
ajax-spider.max-crawl-states: The maximum number of states that the crawler should crawl (default value 0 = no limit)
ajax-spider.max-duration: The maximum duration the ajax spider can crawl (in minutes)
ajax-spider.browser-windows: The number of windows to be used by AJAX Spider
ajax-spider.event-wait: The time to wait after an event (in milliseconds)
ajax-spider.reload-time: The time to wait after the page is loaded before interacting with it (in milliseconds)

passive-scan.enabled: Whether or not the passive scanning is enabled (Note: the enabled state is not persisted)
passive-scan.scope-only: Whether or not the passive scan should be performed only on messages that are in scope
passive-scan.max-alert: The maximum number of alerts a passive scan rule should raise
passive-scan.alert-treshold: The alert threshold of the passive scanner with the given ID (OFF, DEFAULT, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH)

active-scan.max-duration: The maximum duration the active scanner can scan (in minutes)
active-scan.max-rule-duration: The maximum duration of an individual active scan rules
active-scan.host-scan: The maximum number of hosts that will be scanned at the same time
active-scan.thread-host: The number of threads the scanner will use per host
active-scan.delay: The delay each request from ZAP (in milliseconds)
